{
  "subtype": "predictive_feature_engineering",
  "focus_variable": "overall_rating",
  "per_column": [
    {"name": "crew_professionalism_attentiveness", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Service-quality dimension extracted from review text; plausibly drives satisfaction and is not a restatement of the rating itself."},
    {"name": "service_personalization", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "A distinct experiential aspect of service; a legitimate external driver of overall satisfaction."},
    {"name": "customer_support_quality", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Support responsiveness is a plausible antecedent of satisfaction, separate from the outcome."},
    {"name": "seat_physical_comfort_and_space", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Physical comfort dimension; predictive of satisfaction. Overlaps with existing Seat Comfort column but is a legitimate driver, not a restatement of the rating."},
    {"name": "food_and_beverage_quality", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Meal quality is a genuine driver; overlaps with existing Food & Beverages column but not with the rating itself."},
    {"name": "cabin_atmosphere_quality", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Ambience dimension plausibly influencing satisfaction; external to the rating."},
    {"name": "onboard_product_amenities", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Amenity availability is a plausible external predictor of satisfaction."},
    {"name": "operational_punctuality_reliability", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Punctuality is a strong, well-known driver of airline satisfaction and is not captured in existing columns."},
    {"name": "ground_and_airport_service_quality", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Ground/airport experience is a distinct antecedent of overall satisfaction."},
    {"name": "aircraft_cleanliness_and_maintenance", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Cleanliness is a plausible driver of satisfaction, external to the outcome."},
    {"name": "pricing_and_value_perception", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Value perception drives satisfaction; overlaps with existing Value For Money but is a legitimate predictor rather than a restatement of the rating."},
    {"name": "seat_class_expectation_consistency", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Meeting expectations (e.g., downgrade surprise) is a plausible driver of dissatisfaction."},
    {"name": "traveler_type_segment", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Segment mediates expectations and satisfaction; a legitimate contextual predictor (though largely duplicates existing Type of Traveller)."},
    {"name": "route_distance_and_flight_duration", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Haul length shapes expectations and experience; a plausible contextual predictor derivable from Route."},
    {"name": "communication_clarity_and_information", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Clarity of information is a plausible external driver of satisfaction, especially during disruptions."},
    {"name": "policy_enforcement_consistency", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Perceived fairness of policy enforcement plausibly influences satisfaction; external to the rating."}
  ],
  "n_predictors": 16,
  "predictive_utility": 0.78,
  "rationale": "All 16 columns are experiential/contextual dimensions extracted from review text (and route/traveler metadata) that lie outside the overall_rating and plausibly carry predictive signal about it. None restate the rating or constitute leakage (they are drivers/antecedents, not deterministic functions or post-outcome facts). As a set they cover a broad, semantically rich span of satisfaction drivers—crew, service, support, comfort, food, punctuality, ground service, cleanliness, value, expectations, communication, and fairness—giving strong predictive leverage. Utility is discounted slightly because several columns overlap with existing rating sub-scores (Seat Comfort, Food & Beverages, Value For Money) and metadata (Type of Traveller, Route), reducing incremental signal beyond the original columns, and because many are themselves derived from the same reviews that drive the rating, risking collinearity."
}
